from collections import Counter
import json
def transform(g):
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r)
    base=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=next(c for c in cnt if c!=base)
    fill=2
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for row in out:
        n=len(row); i=0
        while i<n:
            if row[i] not in (marker,base): i+=1; continue
            j=i
            while j<n and row[j] in (marker,base) and (j==i or row[j]!=row[j-1]): j+=1
            seg=row[i:j]
            if seg.count(marker)>=2:
                mid=[k for k,c in enumerate(seg) if c==marker]
                lo,hi=mid[0],mid[-1]
                for k in range(lo+1,hi):
                    if seg[k]==base: row[i+k]=fill
            elif seg.count(marker)==1:
                row[i]=base
            i=j
    return out
